rules.positive: Decode payload under the named CDDL root, encode the six-item envelope, compare canonical_hex byte-for-byte, then SHA-256 it.
rules.negative: Reject with the stable error_code before persistence or digest acceptance. When field_path supplies a set-like field fragment or another typed field fragment, input_cbor_hex is decoded as that field value under the named context; otherwise it is a complete root or canonical envelope.
rules.normalization: AST nodes are [type, value], where type is uint, f64_bits, text_codepoints, array, map, or set; every listed input converges to expected_payload_cbor_hex. record_set_override supplies a complete persisted-root template plus a set-like field override; derived digests are recomputed after normalization.
rules.hex: Lowercase, two digits per octet, no whitespace.
rules.semantic: Apply the registry selected by field_path. Enum cases prove accepted/rejected codes; set cases normalize or reject by the named ordering, duplicate, and identity policies; idempotency cases derive only PRESENT identities from the complete persisted namespace. record_enum_binding validates the complete root envelope. record_reference_kind_binding replaces container_field_path in the complete positive envelope named by record_template_case_id with each accepted or rejected container CBOR value before strict validation. operation_field_binding mutates the referenced complete operation envelope at field_path. derived_ordering_component computes the registered domain-separated component. record_to_reference recomputes both id and digest from every persisted record and the named operation envelopes. record_conditional_constraint validates a complete persisted record against discriminant-selected presence, absence, reference-kind, relation, and range rules. typed_value_constraint strict-decodes the complete inner envelope and verifies outer schema/version equality, authorized operation, exact-byte digest, and canonical re-encoding. linked_record_constraint applies one append-scoped or atomic-publication constraint to a self-contained scenario and either accepts it unchanged, rejects an exact replacement-record mutation, or rejects the complete durable input scenario named by input_scenario_id before persistence.

semantic.identity_guard: Two records equal through validator-hash are an identity collision before ordering. This probe isolates the registered derived component.
